name: Agentfile
description: Agentfile — a dependency-free CLI scaffolder on the FlashyOS mesh. From a few answers it writes the estate's existing accountability contracts — flashyos-charter.json, flashyos.json and frontdoor.json — to well-known paths, so an organisation can state who is accountable for the agents it runs without inventing a new format. AAO expands to Agentic Autonomous Organization.

roles.name: canon
roles.purpose: Maintains the scaffolder and the mapping from an organisation's answers to the estate's existing contracts — the charter, the mesh handshake and the front door. It generates records in formats specified elsewhere; a file it writes is valid against the format that owns it, refused rather than guessed.
roles.measure: Generated files that validate against the estate format they target, as a share of what the CLI writes

roles.name: conformance
roles.purpose: Runs the estate's dependency-free checkers against the files the CLI generates, and reports which contracts a run passes rather than a green tick that read nothing.
roles.measure: Generated contracts passing their estate checker, as a share of what the CLI writes

roles.name: release
roles.purpose: Cuts versioned releases of the CLI with a changelog entry, so a version says what the scaffolder will refuse and never moves once it ships.
roles.measure: Releases with a changelog entry, as a share of tags

roles.name: adoption
roles.purpose: Helps an organisation answer the accountability question and reach conformance on the files it publishes, because a scaffolder earns its place only when a real adopter's files pass — never before.
roles.measure: Adopters whose generated files reach level two, as a share of enquiries

roles.name: review
roles.purpose: Reviews a change to what the scaffolder writes before it lands, because a change to a generated contract's shape breaks every organisation that already published one.
roles.measure: Changes to generated output carrying an approving review, as a share of merges
